items.description: Map repository modules and execution flow
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/repo_map.md documenting .archivara/concept_evolve.py, .archivara/semantic_scholar.py, .opencode/tools/*.ts, .opencode/agents/*.md, and artifact flow into results/ with at least one dependency diagram.

items.description: Formalize target theorem and bound-improvement milestones
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/problem_statement.md with formal definitions of B_u and C_57c, current lower bound 0.5708858, and three quantitative milestones (for example +1e-4, +5e-4, +1e-3).

items.description: Delegate web paper discovery and synthesis shortlist
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least one exploration subagent pass for web literature discovery and one synthesis pass for consolidation; save prompts/outputs in results/literature/subagent_runs/ and produce results/literature/shortlist.md with at least 20 candidate papers.

items.description: Search web for code repositories and toolchains
items.acceptance_criteria: Using web search, catalog at least 8 relevant repositories or toolchains in results/literature/code_landscape.md, each with URL, license, target method class, and expected transfer value for tighter-bound research.

items.description: Create and maintain sources.bib with traceable citations
items.acceptance_criteria: Create repo-root sources.bib with BibTeX entries for all consulted sources, including Skinner 2009 and Yanagihara 1995, and at least 10 relevant papers cross-referenced from results/literature/annotated_bibliography.md.

items.description: Define reproducible baseline pipeline and runbook
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/baseline/runbook.md listing baseline commands, inputs, outputs, deterministic seed policy, and exact artifact paths required for each run.

items.description: Reconstruct certified baseline bound from prior methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce baseline artifacts under results/baseline/ that recover a certified lower bound at least 0.5708858 - 1e-6, with assumptions explicitly tied to sources.bib references.

items.description: Specify metrics schema for tighter-bound tracking
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/baseline/metrics_schema.json with fields for certified_bound, rigor_mode, runtime_seconds, numerical_margin, and delta_vs_skinner2009; validate schema against at least one baseline result file.

items.description: Materialize and inspect concept-tree modules
items.acceptance_criteria: Generate results/concept_evolve/tree/ with at least 14 concept folders plus index.json, adjacency.json, and walk_paths.json; each concept folder must contain concept.json and README.md.

items.description: Delegate baseline gap analysis with exploration synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration subagent pass over baseline artifacts and one synthesis pass over findings; publish results/baseline/gap_analysis.md with top 5 ranked bottlenecks and linked evidence.

items.description: Prioritize high-value concept paths for method design
items.acceptance_criteria: Traverse results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json and select at least 3 high-value paths; document rationale, dependencies, and expected signal in results/research/path_selection.md.

items.description: Design novel approach A for certified bound gain
items.acceptance_criteria: Write results/research/approach_A_spec.md with algorithm steps, parameterization, proof obligations, and a target improvement threshold above 0.5708858.

items.description: Design novel approach B with rigorous verification layer
items.acceptance_criteria: Write results/research/approach_B_spec.md defining optimization variables, certification checks, and fallback behavior when rigor conditions are not met.

items.description: Delegate per-approach decomposition and synthesis reviews
items.acceptance_criteria: For each selected approach, run exploration subagent decomposition and synthesis consolidation; archive outputs in results/research/subagent_design_reviews/ and produce a merged results/research/research_backlog.md.

items.description: Create hypothesis ledger with stop-go gates
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/research/hypotheses.json containing at least 6 hypotheses, each with measurable pass/fail thresholds, dependency item IDs, and estimated bound gain.

items.description: Construct experiment matrix for all candidate methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/matrix.csv with at least 30 planned runs spanning baseline and both novel approaches, including parameter grids, seeds, and expected outputs.

items.description: Execute experiments with reproducibility artifact discipline
items.acceptance_criteria: Store per-run artifacts in results/experiments/runs/ with config, logs, metrics, and checksums; at least 95 percent of planned runs complete without missing required files.

items.description: Certify best bound and numerical robustness
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce results/experiments/certified_bound_report.md containing the best certified lower bound, interval or rigor details, and independent confirmation from at least two reruns or environments.

items.description: Compare outcomes against prior work from literature
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/prior_work_comparison.md comparing final metrics to Skinner 2009 plus at least 3 additional papers from sources.bib, with absolute and relative deltas.

items.description: Delegate anomaly triage using exploration and synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Run exploration subagent analysis on failed or unstable runs and synthesis consolidation of root causes; publish results/experiments/anomaly_triage.md with corrective actions and rerun criteria.

items.description: Assemble final claim package and theorem statement
items.acceptance_criteria: Draft results/final/claim.md stating final bound, assumptions, certification scope, and explicit designation of proven vs empirical components.

items.description: Publish concept-tree retrospective with outcome mapping
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/final/concept_tree_retrospective.md mapping selected results/concept_evolve/tree/ modules to outcomes (win, neutral, fail) and downstream dependency effects.

items.description: Write full technical report with citation compliance
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce results/final/report.md covering problem, methods, experiments, and limitations with in-text citation keys that resolve to sources.bib, citing at least 10 papers.

items.description: Delegate independent audit then synthesis sign-off
items.acceptance_criteria: Run reviewer-oriented exploration audit and synthesis pass; save results/final/audit_log.md with reproducibility checks, risk register, and required pre-publication fixes.

items.description: Deliver handoff checklist and next-iteration roadmap
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/final/handoff.md with artifact inventory, unresolved issues, and at least 5 prioritized next experiments tied to specific rubric item IDs.
